token_estimator: ceil(UTF-16 code units /4), independently per file or section; section estimates are not additive to file estimates because of rounding
method: Five disjoint source groups: nine faff shared reference files, then each of graft/beep-boop/prep/tidy SKILL.md. Shared gateway SKILL.md is outside the reference group. Declared entry loads overlap these groups and must not be summed as separate source.
ATX Markdown headings indexed outside fenced backtick/tilde code. Direct spans partition file bytes with preamble. Subtree spans extend to next heading at same/lower level and overlap descendants.

Original files reloaded from baseline commit and matched original snapshot SHA256. Existing ledger identifies accepted body slices versus catalogue description-only coverage. No paragraph-level semantic review or new compression/fidelity claim.
Current section labels are mapped mechanically to known accepted scopes. Reporting is explicitly partial; unchanged owner/heartbeat content nested under Run ledger is not treated as newly measured.
